script: More than 500 million years ago, a top predator of the seas was Anomalocaris. It may have reached about 1 meter long, huge for its time. It had two spiny grasping arms in front of its mouth. It swam by rippling flaps along the sides of its body. This was during the Cambrian explosion, when many animal groups first appear in fossils. Trilobites, some of the most common fossils on Earth, lived alongside it. Follow DinoBytes for more prehistoric facts.
